The '''Renillis system''' was located in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which linked it to the [[Mechis system/Legends|Mechis]] and [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point by [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'' establishes that [[Miletta Sabrin]] was appointed [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the Renillis [[Star system/Legends|system]] more than four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, Sabrin must have become Governor at some point by [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].</ref> the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] [[Miletta Sabrin]] was appointed the [[Imperial Prefect|Prefect]] of the Renillis system. Subsequently, she was promoted to the important post of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]. For more than four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of<ref name="GG11" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="GG11" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sabrin governed the system with no incident, maintaining peace via firm rule.<ref name="GG11" />

Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="GG11" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> however, Sabrin became disillusioned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and, commandeering a small [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], she and a group of her supporters left [[Imperial Space|Imperial space]] for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Samix sector/Legends|Samix sector]].<ref name="GG11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Renillis system was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG11" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square L-14.<ref name="TEA" />
